title: Run planned 'fails without the fix' demos and show them to the verifier
summary: After the producer finishes, Athena runs each planned demonstration that has a fails_without on a scratch copy of the candidate with the fix reverted, and records command, exit code and output tail under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' in the verifier brief. Goal: stop correct changes (retries of jobs 20261103-193428-df2m and 20261103-222737-zzsr) failing because the verifier can never see the failing run; audience is the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for both the failing-run and not-failing cases; fmt, clippy and test pass.
Criteria are checked by cargo test runs.
Single focused change; drain work deferred.
Fixes the verifier's blind spot once, rather than per job.
Criteria check the record appearing in the brief, not wiring.
Outcome is the verifier seeing the failing run.
Docs and comments written for outside readers.
Enforced by Athena running the demonstration, not by prose.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs (verification_stage builds VerifierInputs.checks from check_runs plus extra 'not a check' entries, then verifier_brief_with_plan), crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (line ~1140 renders 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' from inputs.checks), crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs (a behavior criterion's demonstration must set fails_without, free text) and crates/athena-core/src/run/tests.rs (plan fixtures with fails_without). The new run happens before the verifier starts; its result is measured directly by running the named test command in a scratch copy, not inferred. No record or data file is added under crates/, so check_record_file/AnyRecord need no change.

The 'planned revert' is read as: in a scratch copy of the candidate, restore the base version of the candidate's changed non-test files, keep the new tests, run the demonstration's command, and record command, exit code and output tail. If the plan's demonstration has no fails_without, nothing runs. No new plan field or planner prompt change (the planner/verifier prompts have almost no token headroom).

The record is added as an extra checks entry like 'criteria-left-to-athena-checks' (not a check, fails nothing); it says whether the test failed (expected) or passed (revert did not make it fail), and the final verdict still rests on the recorded fmt/clippy/test checks.

Prior jobs: 20261103-193428-df2m and 20261103-222737-zzsr changed drain.rs, tests/drain.rs, main.rs and CHANGELOG.md for the needs-accepting job-limit behaviour. Their code was judged correct; their only finding (missing failing run) is addressed here by this fix, and re-running that work is a separate follow-up request, so those four files are excluded in out_of_scope (work not kept in this job).
Scope kept to one deliverable (Athena running and briefing the demonstration); wall time forecast stays under verifier_timeout_s of 2400s.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p athena-core` (filtered to the new test): a test where a plan has one demonstration with fails_without and the reverted copy makes the named test fail; the verifier brief it builds contains that demonstration's recorded run (command, non-zero exit code, output tail) under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core` (filtered to the new test): a test where reverting does not make the named test fail; the brief's record says the test passed without the fix, and it is not presented as a failing run.
Run `cargo test -p athena-context`: briefs.rs renders the demonstration record in the brief; a rendering test checks the text appears with command, exit code and output tail.

The demonstration runs in a scratch copy: Grep/diff of verification.rs (or the checks stage) shows the candidate tree and the candidate commit are not modified, and the scratch copy is removed afterwards.
The record is an entry that fails nothing ('not a check'), so the final verdict still rests on the recorded fmt, clippy and test checks.
Outcome-check/tested: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass as recorded under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree'.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying the verifier now sees Athena's recorded 'fails without the fix' run.

out_of_scope: Re-doing the needs-accepting job-limit work of jobs 20261103-193428-df2m and 20261103-222737-zzsr: crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs and crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs are not changed here; that is a follow-up request once this lands.
Giving the verifier a way to change files or run reverts itself.
Passing the producer's report to the verifier.
Adding a machine-readable revert field to plans or changing planner/critic/verifier prompts.
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or other governance files.
departures: Higher cost and lower pass rate than reference: touches the run pipeline and verifier brief, and the revert semantic is an assumption; wall time capped near the 2400s verifier timeout.
urgent_reason: Cuts failed and rejected attempts: two retries (20261103-193428-df2m, 20261103-222737-zzsr) were rejected only on this gap.
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline and what the verifier is shown, which decides the gate that judges every job.
